captions.detailed: A classic monocular laboratory microscope featuring a light grey horseshoe-shaped base and a matching curved supporting arm. It has an inclined monocular eyepiece tube on top, a black square mechanical stage in the middle, and a small rotating nosepiece with objectives. The objective nosepiece rotates continuously around the vertical axis, while the mechanical stage is designed to slide on dual perpendicular horizontal axes for sample positioning.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a laboratory monocular microscope with a light-grey horseshoe base, a curved arm, an inclined eyepiece, and a black square mechanical stage. The objective nosepiece should rotate on a continuous joint, and the stage should slide along two orthogonal horizontal axes.
captions.factory: The code defines an articulated assembly starting with a horseshoe base and a curved arm. It models the inclined monocular tube using extruded or angled cylinders. It constructs the rotating turret using a revolute/continuous joint about the Z-axis, and builds a dual-axis mechanical stage using nested prismatic joints (sliding left-to-right and fore-to-aft) with square plates and adjustment knobs.
